correctness.rationale: Conjugating N=J2⊕0_b yields every commuting X as unique [[a,f,c],[0,B,g],[0,0,a]]; square-zero forces a=0 over any finite field, B²=0, fB=Bg=0, fg=0, and c free. B rank r corresponds to I=imB ⊂ K=kerB flags and an isomorphism W/K→I, giving M=[b r]_q[b-r r]_q |GL_r(q)|. H=K/I has s=b-2r dimensions; f and g each have q^r lifts of φ∈H* and h∈H with φ(h)=0. Rank comparison of the graph image yields exact R=r,r+1,r+2 fibers M q^(2r), M q^(2r)(q-1+2q(q^s-1)), M q^(2r+1)(q^s-1)(q^(s-1)-1) for s≥1. Summing yields M[q^(2b-2r)+(q-1)q^b]. Characteristic 2 and s=0 boundaries hold. Independently enumerated ALL B,f,g,c for q,b=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3) and recomputed both ranks, totals 44,315,576.
